question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
-- Final query - get all results
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        CAST(MIN(lt.term_start) AS DATE) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
),
dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(date '1842-12-31', date '2067-12-31', INTERVAL '1' YEAR)) as check_date
),
legislator_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        d.check_date,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(d.check_date, ft.first_term_start))::INTEGER as years_elapsed
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN dec31_dates d
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(d.check_date, ft.first_term_start))::INTEGER > 30 
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(d.check_date, ft.first_term_start))::INTEGER < 50
),
serving AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.id_bioguide,
        ld.check_date,
        ld.years_elapsed,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ld.id_bioguide
              AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ld.check_date
              AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ld.check_date
        ) as is_serving
    FROM legislator_dates ld
)
SELECT 
    years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM serving
WHERE is_serving = true
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed

SELECT SUM(distinct_legislators) as total
FROM (
    WITH first_terms AS (
        SELECT 
            l.id_bioguide,
            CAST(MIN(lt.term_start) AS DATE) as first_term_start
        FROM legislators l
        JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
        WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
        GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
    ),
    dec31_dates AS (
        SELECT unnest(generate_series(date '1842-12-31', date '2067-12-31', INTERVAL '1' YEAR)) as check_date
    ),
    legislator_dates AS (
        SELECT 
            ft.id_bioguide,
            ft.first_term_start,
            d.check_date,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(d.check_date, ft.first_term_start))::INTEGER as years_elapsed
        FROM first_terms ft
        CROSS JOIN dec31_dates d
        WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(d.check_date, ft.first_term_start))::INTEGER > 30 
          AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(d.check_date, ft.first_term_start))::INTEGER < 50
    ),
    serving AS (
        SELECT 
            ld.id_bioguide,
            ld.check_date,
            ld.years_elapsed,
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ld.id_bioguide
                  AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ld.check_date
                  AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ld.check_date
            ) as is_serving
        FROM legislator_dates ld
    )
    SELECT 
        years_elapsed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
    FROM serving
    WHERE is_serving = true
    GROUP BY years_elapsed
)
